==Notes==
*If you recast this skill while it is still active, the healing effect will not happen.
*To determine the total damage reduction when combining skills like [["They're on Fire!"]], multiply the % of damage not reduced of each skill by each other, and the result is the % of damage your affected party takes (provided all conditions are met). 
**Example (assuming all conditions are met, i.e. burning, in earshot, etc.):
***"They're on Fire!" at [[Leadership]] 12 = 29% reduction / 71% damage
***"There's Nothing to Fear!" at Sunspear rank 5 to 10 = 35% reduction / 65% damage
***(ToF) .71 x (TNtF) .65 = .46 (or 46% damage is received / 54% reduction)
{{bug|When sorting skills by campaign, this is listed under [[Core]] although it's a Nightfall skill.}}

==Trivia==
*This skill name was inspired by the [[w:Franklin_D._Roosevelt|Franklin D. Roosevelt]] speech referencing the phrase "...the only thing we have to fear is fear itself..." ([http://wiki.guildwars.com/index.php?title=User_talk:Emily_Diehl/Trivia_archive&oldid=204605#.22There.27s_Nothing_to_Fear.21.22 source]).
